title: 2D Contour: generate finish bands for closed planar rings

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: area:mcp
labels.description: MCP server and agent tooling (crates/app/src/mcp, camcraft-mcp skill)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Implement the first supported slice of the research in #4204.

Add optional finish bands for closed planar rings with Computer compensation and no tabs.
Keep the disabled generator unchanged. Refuse enabled sequences on forms that later slices do not support.

Use S + A for roughing. Use S + A * ((N - i) / N) for finishing. Set the final offset directly to S.
Keep the internal floor allowance at S. Separate it from the radial allowance.
Generate fresh leads and depth ladders for each band. Use a clearance approach between radial bands.
Apply the active wall feed before lead and automatic entry feeds are calculated. Keep explicit entry feeds and spindle speed unchanged.
Keep the crossing law active. Refuse unsafe later passes as an operation error.

Store optional finish and finish_feed records. Missing records retain the old behavior.
Validate field values at the command boundary. Check finite sums, count limits and the total work bound.
Add a project-format version step so that old readers cannot drop enabled finish data silently.
Preserve old digest bytes when both records are absent. Include every present field in the digest.

Use the existing undoable commands for MCP create and update.
Support null removal and omitted-field preservation. Register optional fields explicitly in MCP discovery and its documentation.

Evidence:
- crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs, Contour arm.
- crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_region.rs and contour_params.rs.
- crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_depth.rs, ladder.
- crates/app/src/operation/params.rs, Contour digest.
- crates/app/src/project/params.rs and params_impl.rs.
- crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs and job.rs.

Done means: disabled CL and posted output remain byte-identical. The 0.30, 0.15, 0, 0 example generates the required bands.
Positive final stock remains. Inside and Outside use the same formula. Zero allowance retains all requested passes.
Tests cover feed inheritance, lead percentages, save and load, cache invalidation, MCP discovery, create, update and removal.
Later failures block posting. Unsupported enabled combinations give an explicit refusal.

Effort: high. This work changes behavior across crates and changes posted G-code. The safety floor applies.
Priority: P6. This issue implements an enhancement from the research proposal.

Part of #4204
